review_adjudication.verdict_law: REPOINT/UPGRADE at refined margin >= 0.08 with cov_w >= 0.30 or tp >= 0.55, topic-gated; CARD_NAMED rows land the review-card anchors; everything else stays with the r0 flag annotated adjudicated-stay; no-guess discipline preserved
review_adjudication.refined_scorer: statement-frequency weighted cov (w=1/sqrt(sf)) + title precision + engine ns + 0.10 raw cov; corpus-derived only
